# evroc_service_account (Resource)

Manages an evroc IAM service account. Service accounts are non-human identities used for programmatic access to evroc APIs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the service account. Immutable after creation.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the service account's purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service account is enabled.
- `project` (String) Project this service account belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service account was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified identifier for the service account (e.g., /iam/projects/<project>/serviceAccounts/<name>).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth client ID assigned to the service account.
- `service_account_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the service account.
